periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes are oriented at approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, with the inferior portions diverging laterally.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna gap is approximately 1.7 times the horizontal diameter of an individual ear region.
